title: Bathroom Vanities
seoDescription: Bathroom vanities in Newington, CT — floating, freestanding and double configurations with finishes, storage and showroom guidance from Kitchen & Flooring Depot.

hero.body: Beautiful bathroom vanities that bring together style, storage and everyday comfort.

styles.heading: Find your everyday style.
styles.body: From wall-mounted floating designs to freestanding cabinets and double basins — choose a configuration that fits your bathroom and your morning routine.

items.title: Floating Vanities
items.body: A clean, modern look with an open, airy feel underfoot.

image.alt: Bathroom vanity installation with open wood shelving and organized towels — Kitchen & Flooring Depot

detail.heading: Floating vanities
detail.body: Wall-mounted vanity cabinets create a lighter look and make cleaning the floor easier. Browse floating vanity inspiration in our gallery, then visit the showroom to discuss sizes and finishes.

items.title: Freestanding Vanities
items.body: Timeless style with generous storage for everyday essentials.

image.alt: Modern freestanding bathroom vanity with brushed fixtures and framed mirror — Kitchen & Flooring Depot

detail.heading: Freestanding vanities
detail.body: Floor-standing vanity cabinets offer a classic silhouette and roomy storage. Compare looks in our gallery and ask our team about configurations that fit your bath.

items.title: Double Vanities
items.body: Shared space made easier for busy mornings — with balanced design.

image.alt: Double bathroom vanity with two undermount basins and soft gray cabinets — inspiration photography

detail.heading: Double vanities
detail.body: Two basins help mornings run more smoothly. See double vanity inspiration in our gallery and talk with our team about layout and storage for your space.

storage.body: Smart layouts and thoughtful storage help keep daily essentials organized — so you can choose a vanity configuration that fits the way you start and end each day.
